result.title: Advancing Infrastructure for the Era of Agentic AI | Ian Buck at AI Infra Summit 2026
result.description:
Agentic AI demands a new kind of AI infrastructure—one built for long context, reasoning, tool calls, sub-agents and efficient performance at scale.

In this AI Infra Summit 2026 keynote, Ian Buck, NVIDIA vice president of hyperscale and high-performance computing, explores the NVIDIA Vera Rubin full-stack AI factory platform.

Vera Rubin delivers a rich ecosystem of developers and partners, a fungible architecture for every model and workload—from pre-training and inference to agentic AI and accelerated computing—and a durable platform that gets faster with every CUDA release across a decade of service.

See how NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, Groq 3 LPX, Vera CPU, NVLink 6, NVLink Fusion and NVIDIA DSX help AI factories generate more tokens from every megawatt.

Explore more from AI Infra Summit 2026: https://nvda.ws/4xKClav  

Learn how NVIDIA NVLink and extreme co-design enable leading performance in the latest SemiAnalysis AgentX benchmark: https://nvda.ws/4yC811H

result.title: The Infrastructure of Intelligence: NVIDIA and OpenAI on a Decade of Building Frontier AI
result.description:
Frontier AI breakthroughs are also infrastructure breakthroughs. In this fireside chat, NVIDIA’s Ian Buck and OpenAI’s Sachin Katti reflect on a decade of collaboration – from the first DGX-1 to the NVIDIA infrastructure powering Astra – and what they’ve learned building and operating AI at unprecedented scale. 

They’ll explore how the relationship has expanded beyond frontier model training, how NVIDIA is using OpenAI technology internally, and what the next generation of AI infrastructure will require. Moderated by Bloomberg’s Dina Bass.

result.title: NVIDIA Bionemo Inference Runtime
result.description:
NVIDIA BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BIR) 

Accelerates biomolecular structure prediction inference for models like OpenFold3 and Boltz-2 on NVIDIA H100 and H200 GPUs.

By optimizing discovery-scale workloads, BIR reduces the energy required to generate 31 million protein complex predictions for the AlphaFold Database by an estimated 1.35 GWh - the equivalent of 18,000 EV charges or 5.4 million electric vehicle miles.
